entry.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Make one highly localized correction to the attached generated Giant Wasp from Resident Evil Outbreak (2003), without rebuilding the insect. The attached image currently has SEVEN leg tips. Remove ONLY the short extra central leg whose tip is approximately x584,y883 in the 1402×1122 input: it descends from under the thorax around x602,y675, bends around x600,y744 and x618,y831, then ends at x584,y883. Remove that entire extra chain cleanly back to its thorax attachment. Reveal transparency where that leg stood and restore only the very small thorax area at its root.
Preserve all SIX OTHER legs exactly as in the attachment, including their existing roots, connected segments, individual terminal tips and overlap order. Their six tips are approximately x267/y869, x407/y864, x475/y1030, x776/y1017, x781/y849 and x872/y909. Do not add, redesign, split, merge, duplicate, move or shorten any of those six legs. The final insect must have exactly six coherent leg chains and exactly six leg terminal tips, not seven.
Do not change the head, face, antenna presentation, thorax, striped abdomen, long stinger, two large torn wing surfaces, wing veins, colors, source edition, overall LEFT-facing direction, lighting or image composition. Do not mirror anything. One entire subject; all existing wing tips, stinger and six retained leg tips stay in frame.
Retain a genuinely transparent background with clean antialiased edges and no floor, shadow, haze, checkerboard or text. This is a localized anatomical correction to a generated sprite study, not a redesign or a native game asset.

authorization: Parent authorized one localized03 after two independent reviewers confirmed seven terminals in02; if03 still invalid, retain trials with no admission.
